page.intro: Your statements arrive through Open Finance using your own free Meu Pluggy account, or from a file exported by your bank.

tutorial.title: Meu Pluggy step by step
tutorial.intro: About 10 to 15 minutes, just once. Check each step as you go.
tutorial.reference: Official reference: <github/>. Questions about Pluggy: ask their Discord community.

s1.title: Create your Meu Pluggy account
s1.line1: Sign up with your e-mail. This is where your bank connections and Open Finance consents live.

s2.title: Connect each bank through Open Finance
s2.line1: Click the main connect button and search for your bank.
s2.line2: You are taken to the bank's app or site to authorize the sharing. Your bank password never goes through Vera or Pluggy.
s2.line3: Repeat for each bank and card (e.g. Nubank, Itaú).

s3.title: Create the developer account on Pluggy
s3.line1: Signing up starts a 15-day trial. Access to your data goes on after it.
s3.line2: In the application, add MeuPluggy to the list of connectors.
s3.line3: Create a development application: it shows the <kbd>Client ID</kbd> and the <kbd>Client Secret</kbd>.
s3.warn: Do steps 3 to 5 within the 15-day trial: after that the setup becomes read-only and you cannot authorize new banks.

s4.title: Authorize Meu Pluggy in the application
s4.line1: In your application, click <kbd>Go to Demo</kbd>.
s4.line2: Pick the MeuPluggy connector and sign in with the account from step 1 (OAuth authorization).
s4.line3: Authorize once per connected bank, not per account.

s5.title: Copy the Item ID of each bank
s5.line1: Still in the Demo, open the <kbd>⋯</kbd> menu in the top right corner and click <kbd>Copy Item ID</kbd>.
s5.line2: Keep one Item ID for each authorized bank.

s6.title: Paste the credentials here
s6.line1: Fill in the credentials form and click Test and connect. The Client Secret is encrypted and never shown again.

credentials.title: Your credentials
credentials.formIntro: The Client ID and Client Secret come from step 3; the Item IDs, from step 5.
credentials.rotateIntro: Paste the Client ID and Client Secret of the new application. Connected banks stay as they are.
credentials.addIntro: Paste the Item ID of each new bank, as in step 5.
credentials.clientIdHint: A code like 3f9a1c2e-…, shown by Pluggy in your application.
credentials.clientSecretHint: It is stored encrypted on the server and never shown again.
credentials.itemIdsHint: One per bank, separated by comma, space or new line. At most {{max}} at a time.

errors.clientIdInvalid: The Client ID is a code like 3f9a1c2e-…
errors.itemIdsRequired: Paste at least one Item ID.
errors.itemIdsInvalid: Some entries are not Item IDs. An Item ID is a code like 8b2c1d3e-…; do not paste the Client Secret here.
errors.itemIdsTooMany: Paste at most {{max}} Item IDs at a time.
errors.invalidCredentials: Pluggy refused these credentials. Check the Client ID and the Client Secret of your application
errors.providerUnavailableTitle: Pluggy did not answer just now
errors.providerUnavailableDetail: Nothing was lost. Try again in a moment.
errors.providerDisabledTitle: Integration not available on this installation yet
errors.providerDisabledDetail: This Vera installation is not connected to Pluggy yet. Meanwhile, import your statements from a file.

results.title: Result per bank
results.notFound: We could not find this Item ID. Check that you copied it from your application's Demo
results.limitReached: You reached the limit of connected banks
results.failed: Pluggy did not answer, try again

configured.label: Meu Pluggy credentials
